value.title: Essere inseguita è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: To add to Karin's problems, there is a new, loud mouth, transfer student who claims to be from a long generation of vampire hunters. Will he find out about Karin?!

value.title: Essere scovata è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Karin has an "accident" in the hallway. The hunter suspects Usui of being a vampire when the blood is found. How will Karin and Usui cover this up?

value.title: Guardare indietro... è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: We get to see Anju and Karin's relationship. Anju has flashbacks of her childhood with Karin.

value.title: Papà è davvero imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Karin fails a test, so Usui tutors her. Karin's dad plays the over-protective dad, and embarrasses Karin by following them around.

value.title: Una piscina! È imbarazzante!
value.synopsis: Winner invites Karin to a pool, so Karin decides to act really rude to him. Will her plan to be "unattractive" change Winner's views of her?

value.title: Il mio fratello maggiore è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Ren sets his sights on sucking Usui's mother's blood.

value.title: Risvegliarsi è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: After trying to bite Usui, Karin feels like she betrayed him, and thinks that he hates her. Meanwhile, Ren is still after Usui's mom.

value.title: Stare insieme fino al mattino è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Karin finally realizes her feelings for Usui. Maki stays over at Karin's house for the first time. How will the family react?!

value.title: L'arrivo di Elda! È imbarazzante!
value.synopsis: The Cultural Festival is coming up, but it's not all fun and games for Karin. New problems arise when her grandma (who looks 16 years old) awakens from her coffin.

value.title: La storia d'amore di Elda è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Elda is after Usui. We see Elda's past, and why she is so against human and vampires relationships.

value.title: L'addio ad Elda è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Everybody is having fun at the cutural festival, except Karin who is worried about Usui getting his blood sucked by Elda. If Elda gets her way, all of Usui's feelings of love will be erased!

value.title: I segreti del mio fratello maggiore sono imbarazzanti
value.synopsis: When Ren was 14, he was placed in a human all boys school, and had a roomate who got picked on a lot because of his girl characteristics. Just another worthless human to Ren, or was he?

value.title: La Vigilia di Natale insieme è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: It's Christmas time. Karin tries to figure out the perfect gift for Usui, and if she should tell him her feelings.

value.title: La prima volta... è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Usui asks Karin on a date, ans she's estatic. Meanwhile Anju is becoming a vampire, and Maki is depressed over Winner- yet Karin is oblivious to both's unhappiness.

value.title: Quel che dovrei fare è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Elda has discovered a way to make Karin a true vampire. What will Karin do? Will she choose to become a real one and be with her family. Or will she choose to stay a blood-maker and stay with Usui?

value.title: Sembrare un bambino perduto è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Karin doesn't know where to go, so she wonders around aimlessly. The battle between Elda and The Vampire Hunter contines. Usui tries to reach Karin, but can't.

value.title: Un addio è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: Usui tells Karin to go be with her family, and Karin learns just how much her parents care.

value.title: Per sempre insieme è imbarazzante
value.synopsis: The final episode in Karin. Will Karin become a normal vampire? Will her family be able to escape the wrath of the vampire hunter? Will it be a happy ending?! Watch it to find out!
